statement: Two current checkout captures, original_live_ast_extension_v1 capability.json and job.json, each have seven conflicting duplicate adversary/* source-map keys. The original outer ZIP versions have zero duplicate keys, so the collision is a later checkout transformation defect, not demonstrated ambiguity in the original archived maps or evidence of a false finite result.

title: R7 promotes refusal plus adversary challenge to an unchecked obstruction terminal
statement: The captured R7 gate always returns UNKNOWN_NOT_CERTIFIED/admitted=false because its functional/physical adapter is unavailable. Nevertheless any VERIFY_SIGN_FREE proposal followed by adversary CHALLENGE sets caught_am=true and terminal_state=OpenSignObstruction. A direct OPEN_SIGN_OBSTRUCTION proposal gets the same terminal. Neither branch checks an obstruction witness, so this terminal and hallucination label cannot establish a mathematical obstruction or an independently measured adversary success.

title: Scripted scores and narrow commitments cannot certify general repair
statement: run_refactoring_packet(max_steps=1) unconditionally reports PASS_TO_MASTER with supplied phi=5.4,gamma=2,active_count=5; run_problem forces its final score to zero independent of problem content. Three evidence commitments hash only task ID, step count and final phi, so distinct source/proposal histories sharing those fields receive the same commitment without a SHA collision. Dialogue speeches assert solver/schema/test checks without performing them. The archive/current runner differences inspected here concern names/imports, not these branches.

title: C005 shape acceptance is not consistency certification
statement: The retained C005 toy-host control accepts an INCONSISTENT response with an empty certificate on its supplied consistent omega=(1,1,-2) triangle. This directly distinguishes schema/checker acceptance from semantic consistency and cannot support a hosted-decoding accuracy claim. Mechanism receipts uniformly mark empirical_result=false and challenge_gate=false.

title: Finite homology contradicts four supplied Betti-label entries
statement: Independent exact rank checks on all eight retained matrix complexes confirm b1=0 for both filled Demo5 complexes, contradicting graph-cycle labels2 and4; the last Demo9 complex has Betti sequence[1,0,1,2,1], contradicting claimed b2=2,b3=0. The22 integral Smith certificates validate the retained integer matrices and expose H2=Z/2 in the Bianchi fixture, without turning labels into geometric-manifold proofs or identifying same-degree cohomology.
